target.statement: Rare cluster C0 at k=5 in KIRC has size 10 (6.85% prevalence) and Jaccard stability 0.787 across 20 seeds.
target.dataset: UCI Gene Expression Cancer RNA-Seq (KIRC subset, n=146)

compute.basis: Small tabular dataset (146x2000), tiny autoencoder and k-means with 20 seeds; all CPU-friendly, but exact cluster sizes/Jaccard depend on unspecified seeds and training details, so a clean re-run may not match exactly.

blockers: Exact reproduction of cluster sizes and Jaccard values may be sensitive to random seeds and autoencoder training stochasticity not fully specified in the paper.
title: Rare Genomic Subtype Discovery from RNA-seq via Autoencoder Embeddings and Stability-Aware Clustering
